description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the LDAP synchronization functionality within the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup methods to configure LDAP server settings, load fixtures, and multiple test cases verifying LDAP entry fetching, user retrieval, and system user creation related to LDAP integration.

classes.name: LDAPSyncServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying LDAP synchronization features in OrangeHRM, including LDAP entry fetching, user retrieval, and system user creation.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initial setup before any tests run, verifying LDAP server configuration.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Setup before each test, loading fixtures and configuring server if needed.

methods.name: configureServerAndLoadData
methods.description: Configures LDAP server settings, binds, and loads LDAP fixtures.

methods.name: testFetchEntryCollections
methods.description: Tests fetching LDAP entry collections with specific search settings.

methods.name: testFetchEntryCollectionsWithOneLevelLookupEmptyBase
methods.description: Tests LDAP entries fetching with one-level lookup and empty base.

methods.name: testFetchEntryCollectionsWithOneLevelLookup
methods.description: Tests LDAP entries fetching with one-level lookup.

methods.name: testFetchEntryCollectionsWithMultipleLookups
methods.description: Tests LDAP entries fetching with multiple lookup configurations.

methods.name: testFetchEntryCollectionsBindAnon
methods.description: Tests LDAP entries fetching with anonymous binding.

methods.name: testFetchAllLDAPUsers
methods.description: Tests retrieving all LDAP users and serializing them.

methods.name: testFetchAllLDAPUsersWithSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Tests LDAP user retrieval handling special characters and LDAP distinguished names.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsers
methods.description: Tests creating system user accounts based on LDAP entries.
